title_zh: 预约检查屋顶渗漏和外墙损坏

scenario.goal_zh: 说明漏水情况及已采取的隔离措施，约定检查时间并在检查后讨论维修选项

context_zh: 租户向房屋维护人员描述雨后漏水情况，安排检查而不是自行处理。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Water came through the bedroom ceiling last night. There is also a damp patch on the external wall.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Is anyone using the room now?

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: No. I have closed it off and moved everyone to the other bedroom.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Thank you. We need a careful examination of the roof before deciding what to repair.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: The marks look extensive, but I cannot tell how much damage is behind the paint.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Neither can I from a description. The inspector will assess the extent of the damage.

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Yes, at nine. Please leave the room closed until the inspection.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: That works. Will we discuss repair options afterwards?

sentences.speaker: Leon
sentences.text: Yes. Once we have the findings, I will call you to discuss the options.
